accountExists: An account already exists for this email.
approveDone: Access approved. First-time setup is pending.
approveIntro: This creates a setup-pending person and sends first-time setup instructions. They cannot sign in until setup is complete.
declineDone: Request declined. A new request can be submitted later.
declineIntro: No person will be created. A new access request can be submitted later.
forbidden: This area is not available with your current access.
languageFollowBrowser: Organisation default (not set, so your browser language)
organizationLanguageIntro: The language for everyone who hasn't chosen their own in Profile. Changes are logged with your name.
profileConflict: Your profile changed elsewhere. Reload to see the current values.
profileIntro: Update your display name and language.
reauthIntro: Enter your current password to continue. This confirms the action in this browser session; it does not create another session.
reauthMismatch: We could not confirm your password.
requestsEmpty: No verified requests are waiting for review.
requestsIntro: Verified requests waiting for a decision.
revokeOthersConsequence: Sign out all other browser sessions. This session and your API keys are unchanged.
revokeSessionConsequence: This browser session will be signed out. Its next authenticated request will be denied. Work already authorized is not reversed.
sessionsIntro: Only your active sessions are shown.
settingsConflict: These settings changed elsewhere. Reload to see the current values.
stateChanged: This request changed. Refresh to see the current state.
